title: How we scout a trail before you walk it
storyboard: Film: naturalist walking a Bengaluru trail at dawn with notebook, marking spots; replaces stand-in trail

scenes.headline: How we scout a trail before you ever walk it
Walk it at the same hour we'll run it
scenes.body: Light, heat and what's active all change through the day.

scenes.headline: Check 2: wide, open paths, so snakes are easy to spot and give space
King cobras are the world's longest venomous snakes
scenes.body: They feed almost entirely on other snakes - this one took a python.

scenes.headline: Day trails around Bengaluru, scouted first

caption:
The walk before the walk

Most king cobras stay under about 3.6 m; the longest confirmed was about 5.6 m.

Source: Britannica. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: BTS that shows real process (timing, path choice) and earns its wildlife fact through safety; king-cobra/02 shows a wild king cobra killing a python (Kaeng Krachan, Thailand), matching the diet line. Scouting steps are illustrative - confirm against Muddy Lessons' actual checklist. video:forest-trail/* is Wolf Creek Falls Trail footage (USA), not wolves - used only as a stand-in trail shot with no location claim; replace with our own Bengaluru trail footage.
